## Data Acquisition & Cleaning - Luis Barraza
```{r}
sheet1 <- read_csv("data/Microbes data - 2023.csv")
sheet2 <- read_csv("data/Microbes data - 2024.csv")
sheet3 <- read_csv("data/Microbes data - 2026.csv")
```

```{r}
clean1 <- sheet1 %>% clean_names() %>%
  mutate(media_na_or_sda=as.factor(media_na_or_sda),
         inside_or_outside=as.factor(inside_or_outside),
         exposure_duration_min=as.factor(exposure_duration_min),
         section=as.factor(section),
         media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp=as.factor(media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp)) %>%
  mutate(media_na_or_sda = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(media_na_or_sda, level = "NUA")) %>% # - Alan (Googled)
  mutate(year = "2023") %>% #added to mark year of data - Alan 
  select(!c("group_name","notes"))

clean2 <-  sheet2 %>% clean_names() %>%
  mutate(media_na_or_sda=as.factor(media_na_or_sda),
         inside_or_outside=as.factor(inside_or_outside),
         exposure_duration_min=as.factor(exposure_duration_min),
         section=as.factor(section),
         media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp=as.factor(media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp)) %>%
  mutate(media_na_or_sda = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(media_na_or_sda, level = "NUA")) %>% # - Alan (Googled)
  mutate(media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp= recode(media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp,
                                   "ampicillin"="amp",
                                   "Cycloheximide 0.0004%"= "cyc",
                                   "AMP 50ug"="amp",
                                   "AMP 50 ug"="amp")) %>%
  mutate(year = "2024") %>% #added to mark year of data - Alan 
  select(!c("group_name","notes"))

clean3 <- sheet3 %>% clean_names() %>%
  mutate(media_na_or_sda=as.factor(media_na_or_sda),
         inside_or_outside=as.factor(inside_or_outside),
         exposure_duration_min=as.factor(exposure_duration_min),
         section=as.factor(section),
         media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp=as.factor(media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp)) %>%
  mutate(media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp= recode(media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp,
                                   "CHX"="cyc",
                                   "Amp"= "amp",
                                   "AMP"="amp",
                                   "AMP 50 ug"="amp")) %>%
  mutate(inside_or_outside= recode(inside_or_outside,
                                   "Inside"="inside",
                                   "inside"="inside",
                                   "Outside"="outside",
                                   "outside"="outside")) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.list), as.double)) %>%
  mutate(media_na_or_sda = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(media_na_or_sda, level = "NUA")) %>% # - Alan (Googled)
  mutate(year="2026") %>% #added to mark year of data - Alan 
  mutate(number_mold_looking_colonies_have_hyphae = is.numeric(number_mold_looking_colonies_have_hyphae)) %>% # - Alan
  rename(total_number_colonies=total_number_colonies_both_mold_non_mold_colonies_cumulative_counts_from_both_days)%>%
  select(!c("group_name","notes", "name_of_the_data_recorder"))
```

```{r}
fulldata <- bind_rows(clean1, clean2, clean3) %>% # - Alan
    mutate(resistance = case_when( # true/false on if there is resistance 
        media_na_or_sda == "NUA" & number_mold_looking_colonies_have_hyphae >= 1 ~ "T",
        media_na_or_sda == "NUA" & number_mold_looking_colonies_have_hyphae < 1 ~ "F",
        media_na_or_sda == "SDA" & number_non_mold_looking_colonies_e_g_no_hyphae >= 1 ~ "T",
        media_na_or_sda == "SDA" & number_non_mold_looking_colonies_e_g_no_hyphae < 1 ~ "F",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown")) %>% 
    rename(mold_col=number_mold_looking_colonies_have_hyphae) %>%
    rename(bact_col=number_non_mold_looking_colonies_e_g_no_hyphae) %>% 
    mutate(mold_resist=case_when(media_na_or_sda== "NUA" & mold_col >=1 ~ "T", #counting how many have resistance to mold
                              media_na_or_sda=="NUA" & mold_col <1 ~"F",
                              TRUE ~ "Unknown")) %>%
    mutate(bact_resist=case_when(media_na_or_sda=="SDA" & bact_col >=1 ~ "T", #counting how many have resistance to bacteria
                              media_na_or_sda=="SDA" & bact_col <1 ~"F",
                              TRUE ~ "Unknown"))

#fulldata <- full_join(test, clean3, by = c("section", "media_na_or_sda", "media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp", "inside_or_outside", "exposure_duration_min",  "days_of_incubation", "number_mold_looking_colonies_have_hyphae", "number_non_mold_looking_colonies_e_g_no_hyphae", "total_number_colonies", "year"), relationship = "many-to-many") # merging csv files pt 2 - Alan
```

```{r}
#This is for pivoting locations - Luis A. 
fulldata <-  fulldata %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols="inside_or_outside",
               values_to = "location") %>% 
  mutate(location=str_to_title(location))

#This is for pivoting additives
fulldata <- fulldata %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = "media_additive_none_cyc_or_amp",
               names_to = "media_additive",
               values_to = "media_add") %>% 
  mutate(media_add=str_to_title(media_add))

#To enable Faceting Otherwise Unnecessary
fulldata2 <- fulldata %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("mold_col","bact_col"),
               names_to = "colony_type",
               values_to = "colony_count")
#Consistent for all three years
```


## Tables & Data Graphing - Luis Alvarez
```{r}
#Summary Statistics of Colony Counts per Media Additive Organized by Year
fulldata %>% 
  group_by(year, media_add) %>%
  summarize(min_colony_counts = min(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_colony_counts = mean(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_colony_counts = median(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_colony_counts = max(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(year, media_add)

#Bacteria colony summary stats
fulldata %>% 
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(min_bacteria_colonies = min(bact_col, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_bacteria_colonies = mean(bact_col, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_bacteria_colonies = median(bact_col, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_bacteria_colonies = max(bact_col, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(year)

#Mold colony summary stats
fulldata %>% 
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(min_mold_colonies = min(mold_col, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_mold_colonies = mean(mold_col, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_mold_colonies = median(mold_col, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_mold_colonies = max(mold_col, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(year)

#Total colony summary stats for outside vs inside
fulldata %>% 
  group_by(year, location) %>%
  summarize(min_total_colonies = min(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_total_colonies = mean(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_total_colonies = median(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_total_colonies = max(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(year, location)

#Total colony summary stats for combined years by location
fulldata %>% 
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarize(min_total_colonies = min(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_total_colonies = mean(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_total_colonies = median(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_total_colonies = max(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(location)

```

```{r}
#Microbes Graphs for 2023

#Bar Graph Visualization
fulldata %>%
  select(year,section,total_number_colonies) %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=section,y=total_number_colonies,fill = section))+
  geom_col()+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 600)) +
  labs(title = "Section per Total Colony Counts",
       y="Total Colony Count")
fulldata %>%
  select(year,section,bact_col) %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=section,y=bact_col,fill = section))+
  geom_col()+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 600)) +
  labs(title = "Section per Bacteria Looking Colonies",
       y="Total Bacteria Count")
fulldata %>%
  select(year,section,mold_col) %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=section,y=mold_col,fill = section))+
  geom_col()+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 600)) +
  labs(title = "Section per Mold Looking Colonies",
       y="Total Mold Count")


#Boxplot Graph Visualization
fulldata2 %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  mutate(colony_type=recode(colony_type,
                            "number_non_mold_looking_colonies_e_g_no_hyphae"="bacterial_colonies",
                            "number_mold_looking_colonies_have_hyphae"="mold_colonies")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=location, y=colony_count, fill = colony_type))+
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width=.8))+
  facet_wrap(~location, scales="free")+
  labs(title = "Colony Counts Indoors vs Outdoors",
       x="Location",
       y="Total colony counts")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 210))
fulldata %>%
  select(year,media_add,bact_col) %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=media_add,y=bact_col,color=media_add))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(title = "Media Additive per Bacteria Looking Colonies",
       x="Media Additive",
       y="Bacteria colony counts")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 200))
fulldata %>%
  select(year,media_add,mold_col) %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=media_add,y=mold_col,color=media_add))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(title = "Media Additive per Mold Looking Colonies",
       x="Media Additive",
       y="Mold Colony Counts")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 200))


#Line Graph Visualization
fulldata %>%
  group_by(year,media_add, exposure_duration_min) %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  mutate(exposure_duration_min=as.factor(exposure_duration_min)) %>%
  summarize(mean_colony_counts = mean(total_number_colonies, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=exposure_duration_min,
             y=mean_colony_counts,
             group=media_add,
             color=media_add))+
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Growing Trends of Exposure",
       x="Exposure Duration minutes",
       y="Average Colony Counts per exposure time")
```

## Shiny App - Alan Vongsavanh
```{r}
library(shiny)
library(shinythemes)
library(shinydashboard)
library(ggthemes)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(paletteer)
```
```{r}
names(fulldata)
```

```{r, eval=F, echo=T}
ui <- dashboardPage(
  skin = "green",
  dashboardHeader(title="Microbe Data"),
  dashboardSidebar(
    selectInput("year",
              "Dataset Year:",
              choices=sort(c("All Years" = "all", "2023", "2024", "2026")),
              selected="all"),
    hr(),
    selectInput("plot",
              "Select Plot Type",
              choices = c("Barplot" = "bar", "Boxplot" = "boxplot", "Line Graph" = "line"),
              selected="bar"),
    hr(),  
    selectInput("x",
              "Select X Axis", 
              choices = c("section", "media_na_or_sda", "exposure_duration_min",  "days_of_incubation", "mold_col", "bact_col", "total_number_colonies", "year", "resistance", "mold_resist", "bact_resist", "location", "media_add"),
              selected="bar"),
    hr(),  
    selectInput("y",
              "Select Y Axis",
              choices = c("section", "media_na_or_sda", "exposure_duration_min",  "days_of_incubation", "mold_col", "bact_col", "total_number_colonies", "resistance", "mold_resist", "bact_resist", "location", "media_add"),
              selected="total_number_colonies"),
    hr(),  
      conditionalPanel(
      condition = "input.plot == 'line'",
      selectInput("line_color", "Group/Color by:",
                  choices = c("location", "media_na_or_sda", "resistance", "mold_resist", "bact_resist", "location"),
                  selected = "media_na_or_sda")
      )
  ),
 dashboardBody( 
    tags$head(
      tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", type = "text/css", 
                href = shinythemes::shinytheme("sandstone")),
      tags$style(HTML("
        body { font-size: 16px; }
        .content-wrapper { background-color: #e8f5e9 !important; }
        .main-header .logo { font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; }
        .data-card {
          background-color: #ffffff;
          border-left: 5px solid #27ae60;
          border-radius: 10px;
          padding: 20px;
          margin-bottom: 20px;
          box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
          font-size: 18px;
        }
        .data-card h4 { color: #2e7d32; font-size: 22px; margin-top: 0; }
        .box-title { font-size: 24px !important; color: #333333; }
      "
        ))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Microbe Data Visualization", 
        status = "success", 
        solidHeader = TRUE, 
        width = 12,
        plotOutput("plot", height = "500px")
      )
    ),
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
  bio_theme <- list(
      theme_minimal(base_size = 16), 
      scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", begin = 0.2, end = 0.8), 
      scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis", begin = 0.2, end = 0.8),
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)))
   
    if (input$year == "2023") { 
      fulldata <- fulldata %>% 
        filter(year == 2023)
    }
    else if (input$year == "2024") {
      fulldata <- fulldata %>% 
        filter(year == 2024)
    } 
    else if (input$year == "2026") {
      fulldata <- fulldata %>%
        filter(year == 2026)
    }
  
    if (input$plot == "bar") { 
       p <- fulldata %>% 
        ggplot(aes(x = .data[[input$x]], y = .data[[input$y]], fill = year)) + 
        geom_col(position = "dodge") +
        labs(title = paste(input$y, "per", input$x)) + 
        theme_few(base_size = 16) + scale_color_paletteer_d("prism::flora")
       p + bio_theme
      }
    else if (input$plot == "boxplot") {
      p <- fulldata %>%   
        ggplot(aes(x = .data[[input$x]], y = .data[[input$y]], color = year)) +
        geom_boxplot() +
        labs(title = paste(input$y, "per", input$x)) +
        theme_few(base_size = 16) + scale_color_paletteer_d("prism::flora")
       p + bio_theme
      }
    else if (input$plot == "line") { 
      linedata <- fulldata %>%
        group_by(year, .data[[input$line_color]], .data[[input$x]]) %>%
        summarize(mean_val = mean(.data[[input$y]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") 
      p <- ggplot(linedata, aes(x = as.factor(.data[[input$x]]), y = mean_val, 
                                 group = .data[[input$line_color]], color = .data[[input$line_color]])) + 
      geom_line(size = 1) + geom_point() +
        labs(title = paste(input$y, "per", input$x)) + 
      theme_few(base_size = 16) + scale_color_paletteer_d("prism::flora")
      p + bio_theme
      }
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
